identity.title: Explain the size of a part in relation to the whole
identity.subject: Maths
identity.unit_title: Unit fractions as part of a whole

keywords.description: The whole is all the parts or everything, the total amount.
A part is some of the whole.
We say that two or more things are equal if they have the same quantity or value.
We say that two or more things are unequal if they do not have the same quantity or value.
Inequality occurs when things are not equal. We use different symbols to show this.

key_learning_points.keyLearningPoint: Parts of the same sized whole can be compared.
A bigger or smaller part of the whole can be shown.
Different parts of the same sized whole can be directly compared based on their size.

learning.pupil_lesson_outcome: I can explain the size of a part in relation to the whole.

misconceptions.response: Use the bottles example in the slides to overcome this. Have a range of different sized containers for water and demonstrate the concept practically.
misconceptions.misconception: The part changes size when the whole changes.
